name: NOI and Cap Rate Review
summary: Extract deal economics from a property memo, calculate Net Operating Income (NOI) and Capitalization Rate, and return structured JSON with all formulas shown
purpose: Extract deal economics from a property memo, calculate Net Operating Income (NOI) and Capitalization Rate, and return structured JSON with all formulas shown. This is the foundational economics check for any CRE deal memo.
assignment_instructions:
Property Memo: --- PROPERTY: Riverview Commons, 789 River Rd, Tampa, FL Year Built: 2010, Renovated: 2022 Total Units: 85 Gross Potential Rent (GPR): $1,785,000/year Market Vacancy Rate: 6.5% Operating Expenses:
  - Property Taxes: $210,000
  - Insurance: $68,000
  - Maintenance/Repairs: $112,000
  - Management Fees: $89,250
  - Utilities: $47,500
  - Marketing/Admin: $23,000
Purchase Price: $14,200,000 ---
Calculate the following and return ONLY a JSON object: 1. Effective Gross Income (EGI) = GPR * (1 - vacancy_rate) 2. Total Operating Expenses = sum of all expense line items 3. Net Operating Income (NOI) = EGI - Total Operating Expenses 4. Capitalization Rate = NOI / Purchase Price
JSON structure: {
  "assignment_id": "cre_memo_noi_cap_rate_v1",
  "agent_summary": "<string>",
  "inputs_used": ["<string: each source field used>"],
  "missing_inputs": ["<string>"],
  "claims": [
    {
      "claim": "<string>",
      "evidence_reference": "<string>",
      "confidence": "<provided | inferred | missing>"
    }
  ],
  "calculations": [
    {
      "name": "<string>",
      "formula": "<string>",
      "inputs": {"<key>": <number>},
      "result": <number>,
      "units": "<string>",
      "assumptions": ["<string>"]
    }
  ],
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk": "<string>",
      "severity": "<low | medium | high>",
      "evidence_reference": "<string>"
    }
  ],
  "assumptions": ["<string>"],
  "open_questions": ["<string>"],
  "final_output": "<string>",
  "self_check": {
    "all_required_sections_completed": true,
    "all_numbers_have_sources": true,
    "assumptions_labeled": true,
    "missing_inputs_disclosed": true
  }
}
Rules: - Vacancy rate must be expressed as a decimal (0.065) in calculations. - Purchase price must be numeric, not a formatted string. - Show the sum of operating expenses as a separate calculation. - All expense line items must appear in calculations[].inputs. - Do not output any text outside the JSON object. Use only the provided evidence unless explicitly allowed to assume; label every assumption; if a required input is missing, say so; do not fabricate facts or cite evidence that was not provided.
